project_info.theme: Wet-look bathroom combo poster for stronger hair and cleaner scalp
project_info.color_palette: Steam Gray, Deep Green, Berry Purple, Bright Pink, White

main_subject.detail: A dramatic bathroom-styled combo poster featuring Cocoon pomelo shampoo, Gleditsia scalp scrub, and Gleditsia scalp tonic arranged on a wet reflective tiled surface, with a magenta circle reading 'COMBO 2 GIẢM 40%'.
main_subject.style: Moody premium hair-care advertising, glossy bathroom product staging, wet commercial still life

composition_elements.text: Visible text includes 'TÓC PHỒNG CHẮC KHỎE DA ĐẦU SẠCH GÀU' and 'COMBO 2 GIẢM 40%'. Product labels for Pomelo shampoo, Gleditsia scalp scrub, and Gleditsia scalp tonic are readable.
items: Top Left: Giant cream headline stacked across the gray tiled shower wall.
Top Right: Pink circular discount badge with white text 'COMBO 2 GIẢM 40%'.
Bottom Left: Green pomelo shampoo bottle standing upright with another bottle lying sideways in the foreground and wet droplets on both.
Bottom Right: Pink scalp tonic bottle balanced against an aqua glass tumbler with reflected highlights and scattered water drops.
Center/Background: Tall magenta scalp scrub tube centered as the hero product, glossy wet floor reflections, tiled wall, and misty side lighting.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Wet reflective gleam, misty highlights, controlled hard shadows, premium shower-scene drama

technical_specs.render_style: High fidelity commercial hair-care still life photography

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality advertising poster for a wet-look hair-care combo in a bathroom setting. Centerpiece is a Cocoon Gleditsia scalp scrub tube standing upright between a pomelo shampoo bottle and a Gleditsia scalp tonic bottle on a reflective wet tiled surface. Background is a gray shower-tile wall with large cream text reading 'TÓC PHỒNG CHẮC KHỎE DA ĐẦU SẠCH GÀU'. Surrounding elements: a pink circular badge 'COMBO 2 GIẢM 40%', a second shampoo bottle lying sideways, an aqua tumbler, water droplets, and glossy reflections. Keep the bathroom atmosphere, wet surfaces, and exact product trio. Technical style: high fidelity commercial hair-care still life photography, directional bathroom studio lighting, wet reflective gleam and shower-scene drama, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
